verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם בְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ לְהִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל־ יְהוָ֑ה הַשָּׂטָן֙ גַֽם־ וַיָּב֤וֹא בְּתֹכָ֔ם לְהִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî hay·yō·wm bə·nê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yā·ḇō·’ū lə·hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ ‘al- Yah·weh haś·śā·ṭān ḡam- way·yā·ḇō·w bə·ṯō·ḵām lə·hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ ‘al- Yah·weh
verses.literal: On another day the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD and Satan also came with them to present himself before [Him]

verses.original: אֵ֥י מִזֶּ֖ה תָּבֹ֑א וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ הַשָּׂטָ֔ן מִשֻּׁ֣ט בָּאָ֔רֶץ הַשָּׂטָ֤ן אֶת־ וַיַּ֨עַן יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר וּמֵהִתְהַלֵּ֖ךְ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê miz·zeh tā·ḇō way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- haś·śā·ṭān miš·šuṭ bā·’ā·reṣ haś·śā·ṭān ’eṯ- way·ya·‘an Yah·weh way·yō·mar ū·mê·hiṯ·hal·lêḵ bāh
verses.literal: Where . . . have you come from said the LORD to Satan From roaming through the earth [he] - replied - and walking back and forth in it

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ הַשָּׂטָ֗ן הֲשַׂ֣מְתָּ לִבְּךָ֮ אֶל־ עַבְדִּ֣י אִיּוֹב֒ כִּי֩ אֵ֨ין בָּאָ֗רֶץ כָּמֹ֜הוּ אִ֣ישׁ תָּ֧ם וְיָשָׁ֛ר יְרֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְסָ֣ר מֵרָ֑ע וְעֹדֶ֙נּוּ֙ מַחֲזִ֣יק בְּתֻמָּת֔וֹ וַתְּסִיתֵ֥נִי ב֖וֹ לְבַלְּע֥וֹ חִנָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- haś·śā·ṭān hă·śam·tā lib·bə·ḵā ’el- ‘aḇ·dî ’î·yō·wḇ kî ’ên bā·’ā·reṣ kā·mō·hū ’îš tām wə·yā·šār yə·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·sār mê·rā‘ wə·‘ō·ḏen·nū ma·ḥă·zîq bə·ṯum·mā·ṯōw wat·tə·sî·ṯê·nî ḇōw lə·ḇal·lə·‘ōw ḥin·nām
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Satan Have you considered . . . . . . My servant Job For [there is] no one on earth like him a man [who is] blameless and upright who fears God and shuns evil He still retains his integrity even though you incited Me against him to ruin him without cause

verses.original: ע֣וֹר בְּעַד־ ע֗וֹר יְהוָ֖ה הַשָּׂטָ֛ן אֶת־ וַיַּ֧עַן וַיֹּאמַ֑ר לָאִ֔ישׁ יִתֵּ֖ן וְכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּעַ֥ד נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·wr bə·‘aḏ- ‘ō·wr Yah·weh haś·śā·ṭān ’eṯ- way·ya·‘an way·yō·mar lā·’îš yit·tên wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer bə·‘aḏ nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: Skin for skin - Satan - replied . . . A man will give up all he owns in exchange for his life

verses.original: אוּלָם֙ שְֽׁלַֽח־ נָ֣א יָֽדְךָ֔ וְגַ֥ע אֶל־ בְּשָׂר֑וֹ עַצְמ֖וֹ וְאֶל־ אִם־ לֹ֥א יְבָרֲכֶֽךָּ׃ אֶל־ פָּנֶ֖יךָ
verses.transliteration: ’ū·lām šə·laḥ- nā yā·ḏə·ḵā wə·ḡa‘ ’el- bə·śā·rōw ‘aṣ·mōw wə·’el- ’im- lō yə·ḇā·ră·ḵe·kā ’el- pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: But stretch out . . . Your hand and strike his flesh and bones . . . and he will surely . . . curse You to Your face

verses.original: הִנּ֣וֹ וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ הַשָּׂטָ֖ן בְיָדֶ֑ךָ אַ֖ךְ אֶת־ שְׁמֹֽר׃ נַפְשׁ֥וֹ
verses.transliteration: hin·nōw way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- haś·śā·ṭān ḇə·yā·ḏe·ḵā ’aḵ ’eṯ- šə·mōr nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: Very well said the LORD . . . to Satan He is in your hands but - you must spare his life

verses.original: הַשָּׂטָ֔ן מֵאֵ֖ת וַיֵּצֵא֙ פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּ֤ךְ אֶת־ אִיּוֹב֙ רָ֔ע בִּשְׁחִ֣ין מִכַּ֥ף רַגְל֖וֹ עַד קָדְקֳדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: haś·śā·ṭān mê·’êṯ way·yê·ṣê pə·nê Yah·weh way·yaḵ ’eṯ- ’î·yō·wḇ rā‘ biš·ḥîn mik·kap̄ raḡ·lōw ʿaḏ qā·ḏə·qo·ḏōw
verses.literal: So Satan . . . went out from the presence of the LORD and infected - Job with terrible boils from the soles of his feet to the crown of his head

verses.original: וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ ל֣וֹ חֶ֔רֶשׂ לְהִתְגָּרֵ֖ד בּ֑וֹ וְה֖וּא יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּתוֹךְ־ הָאֵֽפֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ- lōw ḥe·reś lə·hiṯ·gā·rêḏ bōw wə·hū yō·šêḇ bə·ṯō·wḵ- hā·’ê·p̄er
verses.literal: And Job took a piece of broken pottery to scrape himself as he sat among the ashes

verses.original: אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וַתֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ עֹדְךָ֖ מַחֲזִ֣יק בְּתֻמָּתֶ֑ךָ בָּרֵ֥ךְ אֱלֹהִ֖ים וָמֻֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ’iš·tōw wat·tō·mer lōw ‘ō·ḏə·ḵā ma·ḥă·zîq bə·ṯum·mā·ṯe·ḵā bā·rêḵ ’ĕ·lō·hîm wā·muṯ
verses.literal: Then [Job’s] wife said to him Do you still retain your integrity Curse God and die

verses.original: כְּדַבֵּ֞ר אַחַ֤ת הַנְּבָלוֹת֙ תְּדַבֵּ֔רִי גַּ֣ם אֶת־ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֗יהָ נְקַבֵּל֙ מֵאֵ֣ת הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים הַטּ֗וֹב וְאֶת־ לֹ֣א נְקַבֵּ֑ל הָרָ֖ע בְּכָל־ זֹ֛את אִיּ֖וֹב לֹא־ חָטָ֥א בִּשְׂפָתָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: kə·ḏab·bêr ’a·ḥaṯ han·nə·ḇā·lō·wṯ tə·ḏab·bê·rî gam ’eṯ- way·yō·mer ’ê·le·hā nə·qab·bêl mê·’êṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm haṭ·ṭō·wḇ wə·’eṯ- lō nə·qab·bêl hā·rā‘ bə·ḵāl zōṯ ’î·yō·wḇ lō- ḥā·ṭā biś·p̄ā·ṯāw
verses.literal: You speak as a foolish woman speaks . . . - he told her Should we accept from God only good - and not . . . adversity In all this Job did not sin in what he said

verses.original: אִיּ֗וֹב אֵ֣ת שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת׀ רֵעֵ֣י אֱלִיפַ֤ז הַתֵּימָנִי֙ וּבִלְדַּ֣ד הַשּׁוּחִ֔י וְצוֹפַ֖ר הַנַּֽעֲמָתִ֑י וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֞וּ כָּל־ הַזֹּאת֮ הָרָעָ֣ה הַבָּ֣אָה עָלָיו֒ אִ֣ישׁ וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ מִמְּקֹמ֔וֹ וַיִּוָּעֲד֣וּ יַחְדָּ֔ו לָב֥וֹא לָנֽוּד־ ל֖וֹ וּֽלְנַחֲמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’î·yō·wḇ ’êṯ šə·lō·šeṯ rê·‘ê ’ĕ·lî·p̄az hat·tê·mā·nî ū·ḇil·daḏ haš·šū·ḥî wə·ṣō·w·p̄ar han·na·‘ă·mā·ṯî way·yiš·mə·‘ū kāl- haz·zōṯ hā·rā·‘āh hab·bā·’āh ‘ā·lāw ’îš way·yā·ḇō·’ū mim·mə·qō·mōw way·yiw·wā·‘ă·ḏū yaḥ·dāw lā·ḇō·w lā·nūḏ- lōw ū·lə·na·ḥă·mōw
verses.literal: Now when Job’s - three friends Eliphaz the Temanite Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite heard about all this adversity that had come upon him each of them came from his home and they met together to go and sympathize with [Job] and comfort him

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂא֨וּ אֶת־ עֵינֵיהֶ֤ם מֵרָחוֹק֙ וְלֹ֣א הִכִּירֻ֔הוּ וַיִּבְכּ֑וּ וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ קוֹלָ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ וַֽיִּקְרְעוּ֙ מְעִל֔וֹ וַיִּזְרְק֥וּ עָפָ֛ר הַשָּׁמָֽיְמָה׃ עַל־ רָאשֵׁיהֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·’ū ’eṯ- ‘ê·nê·hem mê·rā·ḥō·wq wə·lō hik·kî·ru·hū way·yiḇ·kū way·yiś·’ū qō·w·lām ’îš way·yiq·rə·‘ū mə·‘i·lōw way·yiz·rə·qū ‘ā·p̄ār haš·šā·mā·yə·māh ‘al- rā·šê·hem
verses.literal: When they lifted up their eyes from afar they could barely recognize [Job] They began to weep aloud . . . and each man tore his robe and threw dust in the air over his head

verses.original: וַיֵּשְׁב֤וּ לָאָ֔רֶץ אִתּוֹ֙ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים וְשִׁבְעַ֣ת לֵיל֑וֹת וְאֵין־ דֹּבֵ֤ר דָּבָ֔ר אֵלָיו֙ כִּ֣י רָא֔וּ כִּֽי־ מְאֹֽד׃ הַכְּאֵ֖ב גָדַ֥ל
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šə·ḇū lā·’ā·reṣ ’it·tōw šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm wə·šiḇ·‘aṯ lê·lō·wṯ wə·’ên- dō·ḇêr dā·ḇār ’ê·lāw kî rā·’ū kî- mə·’ōḏ hak·kə·’êḇ ḡā·ḏal
verses.literal: Then they sat on the ground with him for seven days and seven nights but no one spoke a word to him because they saw - how intense his suffering was
